subject: Forecast Lint & Evidence Runbook — Pre-board Readiness
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Schultz <dana@maplehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Forecast Lint & Evidence Runbook — Pre-board Readiness

Team,

We have one week until the pre-board packet freeze. I want a short, surgical sweep across all deals currently in commit and commit-adjacent stages so the board packet reflects defensible ARR and bookings. Please treat this as the single-source action window for changes to committed numbers.

High level asks (deadline: Tue, 11 May EOD PT):
- Confirm stage and close date for every deal tagged as commit / commit-probable. If a deal moved, mark the new stage and reason.
- Upload supporting evidence to the evidence folder listed below. Evidence = signed contract (or countersigned SOW), POs, or explicit CFO email approving start date.
- For each deal provide one-line rationale if you are keeping it in commit (ACV, legal hold, payment term).
- Attach the HubSpot export of your deals to the thread so finance can reconcile.

Attachments: forecast-lint-checklist.xlsx (checklist), evidence-index.pdf (template for the packet).
Drive evidence folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/forecast-lint-2027
HubSpot reference: https://app.hubspot.com/reports-dashboard/forecast

Why this matters: the board packet will show ARR corridor and bookings. In past runs we had 2-3 deals with late-stage changes that created last-minute adjustments. We need to lock the commit corridor for the packet and capture clear reasons for anything we exclude.

Please reply on-thread with your export and any outstanding blockers. I will collate and hand off to finance for reconciliation tomorrow.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>

I uploaded a working file to the drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/forecast-lint-2027 (folder: ben-hs-exports). Expect an initial sweep by EOD today and a full pass by Monday morning. I'll include HubSpot deal ids in the CSV so finance can tie to ledger entries.

Attachment: hubspot-export.csv (first pass)

Ben

Can you confirm the signed date you will use for revenue recognition?

On Sun, May 9, 2027 at 9:02 AM, Kimberly Park wrote:
> High level asks (deadline: Tue, 11 May EOD PT):

Looping in a quick finance note and attachment. I reviewed the May-commit corridor and found two items that need adjustment:

1) D-43312 (Maple Health) — PO is present but the signed contract page we have is the redline accepted by legal on 4/25; the countersigned PDF with the effective date is dated 5/17. That moves revenue recognition to next quarter.
2) D-43901 — AE confirms onboarding is delayed; recommend moving to commit-review but remove from ARR for this packet.

I attached arr-adjustments-v2.xlsx with the reconciled corridor and a short notes column per deal. Finance will reconcile journal entries after we freeze.

Action items:
- Ben: flag D-43312 as missing final signature in the tracker and remove from May closed-won list.
- Kimberly: confirm communication to the Maple contact (Dana) re recognition date and rationale.

Attachment: arr-adjustments-v2.xlsx (updated ARR sheet)

Thanks team. Short and firm:
- Any deal in commit that does not have its required evidence in the drive by 17:00 PT today is out of the commit corridor for the board packet.
- No revisions to committed ACV after 17:00 PT unless a documented CFO exception is filed and copied to the board packet owner.

I want clean traceability. If you need cover for late approvals, escalate now.

Vivek

Final status and next steps:
- Ben uploaded the hubspot-export.csv and annotated flags. Good coverage; flagged 5 deals as missing evidence (including D-43312).
- Laura submitted arr-adjustments-v2.xlsx showing D-43312 moved to next quarter; finance will exclude it from ARR corridor.
- Evidence folder updated: all committed deals except the 5 flagged now have either signed contracts or CFO approval emails.

Outstanding for board packet:
- Dana / Maple Health: please confirm the countersigned PDF date or provide explicit note that revenue can be recognized effective 5/17. If not, we will exclude D-43312 from May ARR.
- Tom Li: if procurement can push the fully executed PO to Dana's team, please upload to the Drive.

I will lock the corridor and hand the packet to Laura by EOD for final ledger reconciliation. If anyone needs to raise a CFO exception, please route through Rishi and copy Vivek.

Attachments: forecast-lint-checklist.xlsx (completed summary)

Thanks all for moving quickly.

Kimberly Park
